text: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Software: Software solutions for detecting and preventing money laundering, including transaction monitoring, customer due diligence, and sanctions screening.; Anti-Money Laundering; AML; AML Software; Transaction Monitoring; KYC; Know Your Customer; Sanctions Screening; Financial Crime Prevention
reasons: GeM does not have a specific 'AML Software' category; relevant tenders are often filed under vague IT services or general software categories, so leaving categories empty ensures we capture all relevant results. The extra terms help narrow down the broad 'software' results to those specifically dealing with financial crime and compliance aspects of AML.
